parallel.requirements: The parallel parent identified the core requirements: infer behavior from the reference binary, implement pure std Rust, provide a Cargo project and root test7.rs, reproduce stoi abort behavior, f32 formatting, wrapping increment, and byte-exact output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent chose a workflow with four independent specification investigators followed by one implementation child and planned later verification, repair, and completeness phases. Implementation ownership existed but was deliberately placed after all spec results.
parallel.implementation: The implementation child began after the spec reports, rechecked the corrected divide-first formula, and wrote Cargo.toml plus src/cxx/mod.rs, src/cxx/fixed.rs, and src/cxx/stoi.rs. It did not reach test7.rs or the indicators modules before termination.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No completed project was assembled. The artifact validation copied only Cargo.toml and cxx support files, and the required entry file test7.rs was absent. The final response file was empty.
parallel.verification: The spec children performed extensive reference probing, but the workflow never reached its planned Verify phase for the implemented project. There was no integrated build, rustc/cargo check, or parity test on a complete deliverable.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with the workflow killed and implementation child still in progress. The final artifact lacked test7.rs, compiled executable, and indicator modules, so the official evaluator passed 0 of 40 testcases.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same pure Rust, no-dependency, root test7.rs, Cargo project, black-box behavior, exact CLI, numeric precision, and output parity requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent owned discovery, implementation, repair, and verification end to end. It probed the reference, wrote files locally, fixed build issues, and then ran whole-program parity checks.
serial.implementation: The serial run created Cargo.toml, test7.rs, cxx/stoi support, and indicators modules for ProgressDisplay and Percentage. It implemented divide-first f32 percentage behavior, wrapping increment, and C++-style stoi plus abort behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial run produced the required root test7.rs and executable /output/test7, with Cargo metadata and module files in the artifact. The official artifact validation reported ok true.
serial.verification: It built with rustc and Cargo, compared the rustc and Cargo binary output, ran 80 directed parity cases, then ran a 3,599-case differential sweep and verified the five documented examples.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished task obligation is visible at closure. The current completed official evaluation retry reports 40 of 40 testcases passed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official records make this a serial_only_pass pair: parallel failed 0/40 and serial passed 40/40. The parallel run learned the hard behavioral facts, including the divide-first f32 percentage correction, but it used a workflow that awaited four spec investigators before starting the implementation child. That child was still writing support modules when the overall run was killed, so the artifact lacked the required root test7.rs and could not pass. The serial run handled probing, implementation, build repair, and parity testing in one trajectory and delivered the complete project.
parallel_contributors: The workflow script gated implementation behind completion of all four specification children.
The implementation child started late and was interrupted before creating the required entry file and indicator modules.
The final artifact validation listed only Cargo.toml and cxx support files, with expected_entry test7.rs and ok false.
serial_contributors: The serial run locally wrote all project files including test7.rs and indicator modules.
It built with rustc and Cargo and ran directed and 3,599-case differential verification.
The current completed official evaluation retry reports solution_passed true and 40/40 passed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The parallel parent initially stated a wrong multiply-first percentage conclusion, but the workflow children and implementer corrected it before implementation; it is not the observed artifact failure.
The serial run initially hit a Python-not-found issue for its fuzzer and replaced it with a Rust fuzzer; this was an ordinary local tool adjustment and not a concurrency issue.
evaluator_effects: The serial cell/evaluation/summary.json is stale from a pre-retry startup failure; the current status.json evaluation supersedes it and reports 40/40 passed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause

candidates.reason: Implementation was explicitly assigned to an implement:/output workflow child, so the problem was late/incomplete execution rather than absent implementation ownership.
The delegated work was not split into separately implemented interoperating components needing reconciliation; the final implementation never reached that integration stage.
The workflow assigned project creation and final placement to the implementer and later verification phases; the assembly was unfinished because the child was interrupted, not ownerless.
The parent workflow itself owned the end-to-end pipeline through Spec, Implement, Verify, Repair, and critic phases, even though it exhausted time before later phases.
The delay came from a broad multi-lens investigation phase, not one mandatory preflight or oracle step.

Four investigators ran as a separate Spec phase and the script awaited all of them before spawning the implementation child; the implementer then had too little remaining time and the deliverable was incomplete.
candidates.realized_consequence: Implementation started after the spec phase and was interrupted with only support files written, leaving the required root test7.rs missing and the official evaluation at 0/40.
candidates.near_match_reason: The implementation task was broad, but the directly evidenced boundary was the prior all-investigation gate; the oversized-child symptoms are the same downstream timeout chain.

The implementer received many obligations, but that is the nearest rejected same-chain explanation; the critical adverse scheduling choice was waiting for all spec lenses first.
The implementation child brief included the task, layout, build, parity, zero-dependency, and test requirements, and told the child to trust corrected lens evidence.

The combined reports were large, but the implementer consumed the key divide-first correction and began implementation; no specific decision failure from excessive handoff bulk is evidenced.
The implementation prompt explicitly instructed the child to prefer lens corrections over the earlier spec, so it was not acting on a stale superseded state.
The reports converged on the divide-first correction by the time implementation began; no unresolved incompatible reports blocked or corrupted integration.
The parallel run did not present a completed solution; final.txt is empty and the workflow was killed before any whole-task acceptance decision.
The only workflow retry was a script parse-error relaunch before child work; there is no replacement child repeating prior implementation without checkpoint state.

retained_patterns.reason: The workflow awaited all four investigation lenses before starting the only implementation child. That deferred productive project writing until late in the run, and the workflow was killed with the implementer still incomplete, producing no root test7.rs. The serial control used its probes while implementing locally and delivered a verified project.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Productive implementation was delayed until the global budget was nearly exhausted, so the implementer was interrupted before writing test7.rs or indicator modules and the official evaluator failed all 40 cases.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The implementer had broad duties, but the distinct correction would be to overlap or shorten the up-front investigation rather than merely split the implementation child.
